newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction - Strong and active demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction - Strong and active demand.

text.p: Strong and active demand was noted at Monday's tea auction in London, with brightest Burundi and Kenya teas gaining five to 10 pence and sometimes more, the official report said.
All others advanced two to six pence, the report added.
The offshore sector saw brighter types meeting good enquiry at dearer rates, but plainer types were irregular.
The next auction will be held on Monday, April 7.
